context: Tests whether the agent implements a custom continuous haptic as one retained, live-modulated player with correct engine lifecycle, fallback, cancellation, and device verification.

checklist.name: Capability fallback
checklist.description: Checks capabilitiesForHardware().supportsHaptics and keeps the control usable with clear visual state when unavailable.

checklist.name: Retained engine
checklist.description: Uses one retained CHHapticEngine owner rather than constructing an engine for each drag update.

checklist.name: Handlers before start
checklist.description: Installs stoppedHandler and resetHandler before starting the engine and handles their callback isolation safely.

checklist.name: Continuous event
checklist.description: Builds and starts a retained hapticContinuous pattern player at gesture start.

checklist.name: Dynamic modulation
checklist.description: Updates the retained player with bounded hapticIntensityControl and hapticSharpnessControl dynamic parameters.

checklist.name: No per-frame recreation
checklist.description: Does not recreate the engine, pattern, or player for each drag update and suggests meaningful update throttling if needed.

checklist.name: Cancellation
checklist.description: Stops and releases the continuous player for normal completion, cancellation, disappearance, and teardown.

checklist.name: Reset recovery
checklist.description: Restarts the engine and recreates invalidated players/resources after reset rather than assuming the player survives.

checklist.name: Power policy
checklist.description: Selects deliberate automatic shutdown or explicit engine start/stop behavior.

checklist.name: Device evidence
checklist.description: Requires physical-device checks for feel, interruptions, repetition, cancellation, fallback, and battery behavior.
